UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile with optional medical & location information for emergency response

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID

name.description: Full name of the user or emergency victim

bloodGroup.description: Blood group for emergency transfusions (A+, O+, etc.)

profilePictureUrl.description: DiceBear generated avatar URL or custom avatar URL

location.description: GPS coordinates and administrative district/block location

profileCompleted.description: Whether user completed and saved their profile

SOSReport.title: SOSReport
SOSReport.description: Emergency distress beacon and audio/text report

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the distress caller

voiceUrl.description: URL to audio recording in cloud storage (or null)

status.description: Current status of the emergency response

userAddress.description: Street or landmark address of victim

Donation.title: Donation
Donation.description: Transparent disaster relief financial disbursement record

sosReportId.description: Referenced SOS distress report or campaign code

donorName.description: Public name of the donor or contributor

donorUserId.description: Auth UID of the donor if signed in

status.description: Current audit stage of the relief aid

sosLocationName.description: Disaster zone or camp location name

proofNote.description: Audit verification and field proof notes

Donor.title: Donor
Donor.description: Verified Google donor profile and cause preferences for transparent disaster relief

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching Google Account

name.description: Full name of the verified donor

phone.description: Contact phone number for receipt delivery and relief audits

preferredCauses.description: List of emergency causes donor prefers to support (e.g. Flood, Earthquake, Fire, Other Emergencies)

/users/{userId}.description: User profile records indexed by auth UID

/donors/{donorId}.description: Verified donor profiles and relief preferences

/sos_reports/{reportId}.description: Emergency SOS distress beacons logged by victims
